buildCommand: curl -L https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v0.144.2/hugo_extended_0.144.2_Linux-64bit.tar.gz | tar -xz && mv hugo /usr/local/bin/ && cd svelte && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p ../site/static/app && cp -r .svelte-kit/output/client/* ../site/static/app/ && find .svelte-kit/output/prerendered/pages -name '*.html' | while read file; do relpath=$(realpath --relative-to=.svelte-kit/output/prerendered/pages "$file"); mkdir -p "../site/static/app/$(dirname "$relpath")"; cp "$file" "../site/static/app/$relpath"; done && cd ../site && hugo --gc --minify
